construction: Reference fields are exactly (w,0,w-prime/r) on the whole polar plane. Actual radial positivity D.a>0 and global smoothness of w provide a single fixed compact bound on [D.a,D.b] for each finite order.
The actual partition of unity supplies a cell containing every physical point; no cell is reassigned and no whole component is assumed contained in one cell.
Installed materialSample_H_E0_envelope absorbs H(sample)^(3/4)*E0(sample)^B uniformly over all actual cells. The N01 coefficient-difference state base, radius, and loss remain exactly unchanged.

Adding the genuine reference jets produces a raw coefficient jet bound with constants before every component, state and physical point. No local chart/clamp, root strip width or profile-box radius occurs in the conclusion.
limitations: This is a raw numerator upper-bound input. Same-witness reciprocal radial coefficient/root-factor costs and nonlinear one-high composition remain separate steps.
Only static source and actual provider inspection performed; no Lean compilation or CI claim.
